test_title: PYST 49: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The income of Raman is ₹91,700. He saves 25% of his income. If his income increases by 27% and expenditure increases by 40%, then his savings will:
solution:
**Given:**

Income of Raman = 91700

Savings = 25 percent of income

Increase in income = 27 percent

Increase in expenditure = 40 percent

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

Increased value = Original value × (1 + Increase ÷ 100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original savings = 25 ÷ 100 × 91700

⇒ Original savings = 22925

⇒ Original expenditure = 91700 − 22925

⇒ Original expenditure = 68775

⇒ New income = 91700 × 127 ÷ 100

⇒ New income = 116459

⇒ New expenditure = 68775 × 140 ÷ 100

⇒ New expenditure = 96285

⇒ New savings = 116459 − 96285

⇒ New savings = 20174

⇒ Change in savings = 22925 − 20174

⇒ Decrease in savings = 2751

**∴ The correct answer is savings will decrease by 2751.**
